name: x-ratelimit
author: 3m1n3nc3
description: Open source browser extension (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) that tracks X rate limits from observed requests.

scripts.safari: TARGET=safari tsdown --config-loader tsx && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location dist/safari-xcode --app-name "Rate Limit Tracker for X" --bundle-identifier com.opensource.xratelimit --swift --no-open --no-prompt --force
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && tsx scripts/zip.ts chrome
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && tsx scripts/zip.ts firefox
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:assets && vitepress dev website
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:assets && vitepress build website
